recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up source edit is recommended for FHIR-6177 unless the work group separately reopens document-bundle wording beyond this historical typo.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive DSTU1 technical correction for FHIR-core-documents section 2.3.0.1.1 asking to change the typo phrase about "the resources that the Lists for the section.content" to wording that correctly referred to referenced resources from the List used for section.content.
initial_application: SVN-mirrored commit 3cd8f0b3255e8ad2fd3fae809e45669d146c4bc3, subject "#6177 - correct document wording", changed source/documents.html and records git-svn-id revision 5626, matching the Jira comments. It replaced the bad "resources that the Lists" wording with corrected wording about resources referenced from the List.
additional_context: source/documents.html remains an active specification page through source/navigation.xml and many current source links to documents.html. Later FHIR-15723 commit 991b2cdaf0b31b7fc50153b930cd1c014e554f92 rewrote the Documents guide, removed the intermediate List sentence, and left broader current rules: resources referenced by the Composition SHALL be included, further referenced resources SHOULD be included, and resources outside Composition and the subject resource are not attested content. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/documents.html contains neither the original typo nor the intermediate corrected List sentence, and it conveys the relevant document-bundle inclusion and attestation guidance in the current page structure.

related_jiras.note: Later Documents guide rewrite that removed the sentence FHIR-6177 originally corrected while preserving current document inclusion and attestation guidance.
